title: Printing Multiple Lines
instructions: One printf prints one chunk of text. Want several lines? Two ways:
Way 1 — use several printf statements, one after another. They run top to bottom.
Way 2 — put more than one \n inside a single printf. Each \n starts a new line.
While learning, one printf per line is easiest to read. Let's do that.
Remember: quotes around the text, semicolon at the end of every line.
task:
Print these three lines, each on its own line:

C is a language.
It is fast.
I am learning it.
expected_output:
C is a language.
It is fast.
I am learning it.
